$comment: Upstream files and behaviours the self-hosted edition depends on. The upstream sync workflow lists every entry whose file an upstream release touches; the named contract test proves the behaviour still holds. Keep this in step with selfhost/docs/PLAN.md §4.

points.contract: startServer({port,host}) resolves {server, port}; the server has exactly one 'request' listener (captured and delegated to); importing has no listen side effect
non-GET requests get 405 before routing, so selfhost must route its own mutations
CORS `*` is set through res.writeHead(status, headers), never res.setHeader, so the selfhost strip wraps writeHead
GET /api/health returns {app:'wickline', version}; the frontend uses it to detect server mode
/api/yahoo/stream is SSE, takes at most 100 symbols, ticks carry the session flag m (0 pre, 1 regular, 2 post, 3 extended)

exports envProxy() and setServerProxy(url) used by the selfhost entrypoint; setServerProxy installs an undici global dispatcher, so selfhost/notify/gotify.mjs uses its own undici Agent (undici stays an upstream dependency)
one <head> tag (injection anchor); the inline head script reads wickline.theme and wickline.paint; the module entry is js/app.js
store.get/set use localStorage keys 'wickline.<key>' holding JSON
direct localStorage use keeps the wickline. prefix (drawings.<symbol>, scripts, lang)
'storage' event listeners keyed on wickline.alerts / wickline.paper / wickline.scripts / wickline.lang drive live remote apply
every key upstream stores is classified in sync/key-classes.json
the URL hash is s=<symbol>&tf=<tf> and is applied over the stored active chart on load (boot.js strips it before a sync reload)
saved scripts are entries {id, name, code, created, updated}; the merge uses id + updated
alert JSON {id, symbol, condition, price, message, active, created, triggeredAt, triggerPrice}; crossing rule and first-tick-ignored, pinned by tick fixtures shared with the server evaluator
Binance @miniTicker combined streams and the Coinbase ws-feed ticker channel, mirrored by the server adapters
PaperAccount API (placeOrder, tick, bar, toJSON) for the optional server execution phase
